en: You shouldn't spend all your money\non drinks.\pTry this instead.
Nothing beats thirst like some hot\nTEA.\pIt really is the best.
My dear POKéMON keep me company.\nMEOWTH even brings money home!

Oh, hello, dearie.
Did you enjoy my TEA?\pBy the way, dear. Are you, by any
chance, from PALLET TOWN?\pA girl from PALLET TOWN, DAISY,
she enjoys TEA every day.\pShe visits the CELADON DEPT. STORE
to buy some TEA.
